title: Black Summoner
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kelvin trades away memories of his past life for strong abilities and is reborn in a fantasy world as a Summoner, with the goddess of reincarnation, Melfina, as his first contracted follower. He discovers he loves fighting and seeks out ever stronger foes, gathering monsters and women, including a half-elf he bought as a slave and the daughter of a former Demon King.
life_message: Life is most thrilling when you keep testing yourself against stronger opponents, with a loyal household at your side.

content.note: Protagonist is a self-described battle junkie fighting knights, demons and monsters (Wikipedia; AniList Swordplay, Demons).
Female harem; heroines act as 'wives' (Wikipedia; AniList); MangaUpdates lists a Rape category, unconfirmed (to verify); MangaDex suggestive.
Kelvin buys a half-elf slave, Efil, who then loves him (Wikipedia).

dominant: Love of combat; power growth; harem household
